claim: Actual compact Hausdorff second-countable simultaneous level3 cusp filling with the original dense open orbit quotient and exactly two distinct actual cusp-disc origins.

obligations.name: Exact objects
obligations.required_input: Original orbit quotient, finite ends, actual q cusp maps and their independent topologies.
obligations.constructed_input: TwoChartGluing318.Space of the exact actual overlap.
obligations.justification: The original Base(image3), original finite End3, actual chosen rotations and actual level-three q cusp homeomorphisms are the gluing inputs. The construction uses TwoChartGluing318.Space on their explicit overlap. Neither a rational sphere nor an unspecified compact source is substituted for the old quotient.

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: Open embeddings on the same punctured-disc overlap.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual inverse cusp maps, disjoint neighborhoods and natural disc inclusion.
obligations.justification: The old punctured-disc map is continuous, injective and open by the exact cusp homeomorphisms and proved disjoint end neighborhoods. The full-disc inclusion is an open embedding with precisely nonzero target coordinate. Those maps supply the exact overlap theorem hypotheses.

obligations.name: Coverage and exceptional cases
obligations.required_input: Every original gluing point and every actual cusp origin.
obligations.constructed_input: Original_or_cusp plus exhaustive original two-end classification.
obligations.justification: All original End3 values occur in the sigma family. The filling's original_or_cusp theorem covers every gluing point, including q=0 and q!=0 cases. End exhaustion proves there are precisely the two named origins. No original elliptic point is deleted or assumed free.

obligations.name: Maps and directions
obligations.required_input: Correct gluing directions and identical q coordinate.
obligations.constructed_input: oldMap, discMap, original_oldMap and both original/chart open embeddings.
obligations.justification: oldMap is the actual inverse q-chart followed by the original neighborhood inclusion. discMap preserves the same complex q. original_oldMap is the exact gluing equality. Both original and disc maps are open embeddings; no topology is transported from the rational T target.

obligations.name: Consumer identity
obligations.required_input: Compactness/separation/complement must concern the same constructed filling.
obligations.constructed_input: Exact compact core/disc image cover, actual j overlap and named cusp complement.
obligations.justification: Compactness uses those same disc images and the original fundamental-domain compactCore. The j-separation consumer uses the original jMap3 on the original quotient and the exact inverse-chart formula in the overlap. The original embedding's complement is the range of that same cusp map, then the two named actual origins.

obligations.name: Local/topological hypotheses
obligations.required_input: Compactness, Hausdorffness, density and second countability without high-level freeness.
obligations.constructed_input: Finite closed-disc compact cover; all-level continuous genuine j and actual cusp growth; punctured-disc density.
obligations.justification: Strictly smaller closed radii give compact subsets of the full charts. The original finite compact-core-and-ends cover applies at3 without a freeness condition. Hausdorff separation of cusp and old points uses ActualJAllLevels318.continuous_j 3 and genuine qj growth; no high-level holomorphic quotient atlas is invoked at3. Density comes from actual punctured-disc density. These are topological, not complex-atlas claims.

obligations.name: Normalizations
obligations.required_input: Actual widths, heights and normalized qj factors.
obligations.constructed_input: Widths in q^w, heights2and3, original G with G(0)=1 and exact denominator.
obligations.justification: The genuine integer width is retained in q_w and q_w^w=q_1. Radius exponents use heights2 and3 exactly. G is the original qj function, analytic with G(0)=1. The exact j overlap formula includes its q^w denominator. No unproved T/q equality or source pole order is silently inserted.

obligations.name: History and dependencies
obligations.required_input: New application requires review; preserve historical high-level source bounds.
obligations.constructed_input: New fixed-level3 construction from proved level3 cusp inputs, leaving old sources untouched.
obligations.justification: The existing AllCuspOverlap/Filling/Compact/QJ/ Hausdorff proofs were compared and specialized using the new genuine level-three cusp inputs. Their old N>=5 source bytes and prior verdicts remain unchanged. This is a changed application needing new review; the old compact complex curve result is not simply relabeled as applicable at3. No manuscript is rewritten and no historical omission is called a newly discovered gap.

obligations.name: Verification and acceptance
obligations.required_input: Exact final source replay and all-private recursive audit.
obligations.constructed_input: Ten freshly replayed sources and exact pinned predecessor closure.
obligations.justification: The receipt binds ten exact source files, all imports, baseline source pins, strict replay logs and recursive private-inclusive axiom audit. Five copied predecessors are rechecked. Independent source review remains distinct from compiler validation and is required before admission.
